title: Financial institutions in India have unanswered questions about AI governance that need attention
description: A feedback window for the Reserve Bank of India's draft guidance on risk management in the context of AI governance is about to close. It sets out a clear set of principles. But financial entities also need clarity on how exactly to uphold them.
